title: DBRS Morningstar Changes Trends on SmartCentres Real Estate Investment Trust to Negative from Stable, Confirms Ratings at BBB (high)
主要内容: DBRS Morningstar revised the credit trend for SmartCentres Real Estate Investment Trust to Negative from Stable, confirming its BBB (high) rating. The downgrade is attributed to elevated leverage, asset-type concentration in retail, tenant concentration, particularly with Walmart Inc., geographic concentration in the Greater Toronto Area, and increasing development execution risks. These factors may lead to higher volatility in cash flows and metrics, prompting the firm to expect SmartCentres to maintain a larger buffer relative to threshold metrics for its rating level. The firm highlighted deterioration in SmartCentres’ key financial risk metrics and possible incremental risks from its acquisition of a two-thirds interest in 53 acres of land in Vaughan, Ontario, for approximately $513 million, funded with $200 million in equity and approximately $313 million in debt. DBRS Morningstar also noted SmartCentres’ strong tenant profile, with Walmart Inc. representing 25.3% of annualized rental revenue, and a large retail property portfolio generating stable cash flow.
